scope: new repository prose; flags require human judgment and may be source titles/technical quotations

flags.text: Read AGENTS.md, LOCAL_STORAGE.md, README.md, knowledge/INDEX.md, knowledge/DATA.md, the experiment registry, CONTRIBUTING.md, REUSE.md, LICENSE, redistribution rules and the relevant first-pass report and retrospective. Use the repository's add-data and start-study instructions. Follow newer unmerged packages as well as the generated registry. The parent has already claimed the eight questions; do not post duplicate claims or contact anyone.

All new data, including downloads, images, rendered pages, OCR, detailed annotations, object records, lexical rows, extracted tables, acquisition responses and scratch, must be physically under D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-<assigned-slug>/. Check D: and the data/raw junction before writing. Source manifests, code, prose and aggregate results stay in the corresponding checkout experiment package. Record logical and physical paths, source titles, URLs, acquisition times, rights, bytes and SHA-256. Preserve previous sources and frozen results.

Maximize reader comprehension; explain the idea directly in connected prose; keep necessary shared assumptions together; avoid repeated corrective comparisons or warnings that interrupt the argument. Read knowledge/editorial/WRITING.md before writing. Preserve exact source titles and frozen evidence wording.

Search bounds: up to eight primary/institutional web queries, the 2009 Kenoyer chapter at the Harappa author route, up to four HARP report or publication pages, and up to two ordinary public PDF routes per relevant source. Stop after this bounded block or after all five cases have source-qualified contexts. Search snippets remain leads. Inspect accessible actual text and record exact pages. Do not contact anyone, pay, inspect reserved cohorts or infer manufacture dates from recovery phases. Source images or descriptions of signs count as exposure. Republished text is one lineage. Raw sources and derivatives stay on D:; only prose, code, manifests and aggregates go in the checkout.

Preserve complete accessible web-tool responses or primary HTML under D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-harappa-context-pass2-review/, with exact source coordinates and hashes. Source notes and extracts stay there too. The C: package contains code, prose, manifests and aggregates. Reuse source bytes without changing the author package. Record tool failures and actual exposure. Reviewed status applies only to the inspected identity and caption chain, not to the remaining five-case search or archaeological dating argument.

All detailed source observations, panel images, downloaded responses and joined metadata are physically at D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-object-identity-pass2/, with logical prefix data/raw/2026-10-24-object-identity-pass2/. Rights remain unresolved and detailed derivatives remain local. The source manifest supplies hashes and source bindings. No shared manifest or coverage page was edited.

Before displaying candidate graphics, we declare the rules. A supported bridge requires either a complete site-qualified accession/registration shared by the publication and corpus metadata, or an individually distinguishable primary photograph matched to a corpus photograph with agreement on damage, outline and inscribed design. A complete identifier conflict blocks admission. Shared site, grid square, object type, legend or motif alone leaves the relation a candidate. A photograph match must identify the same carrier through at least two distinctive physical details and preserve alternate orientation, crops and uncertain observations. Source dependence is recorded. New matches remain agent source checks, with specialist acceptance pending.

We inspect the held corpus object, face and image metadata for this ten-row block and its inherited candidate families, retaining every alias and conflicting identifier. We use the Dholavira preliminary report's individual catalogue image panels and identity columns. Search is bounded to the ten accession entries and metadata for their candidate families, plus up to twenty adjacent catalogue or institutional pages needed to resolve aliases. We may use new institutional catalogue/accession evidence or the final edition when the preliminary scan is insufficient, keeping editions separate. Stop when all ten have explicit dispositions or these bounds are exhausted. Missing image, ambiguous match and contradicted match are separate outcomes.

All new raw data, extracts, images, joined records and scratch live physically at D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-object-identity-pass2/, logically data/raw/2026-10-24-object-identity-pass2/. Code, prose, aggregate results and source/hash manifests stay in this package. Preserve earlier inputs and outcomes. Record exact displayed images, content and participant; no reserved confirmation payload is opened, no examined object is called fresh. This source study submits no segmentation, restoration or functional reading claim and evaluates no spent statistic. The relevant bench protocols were consulted in the first pass; no applicable synthetic scorer is required for these catalogue identities.

The new asset is a 100 by 115 pixel public preview of Frenez's 2007 poster. It adds no readable object-level image. The full poster PDF and 2024 article pixels remain acquisition targets. All new acquired material, source derivatives, detailed records and failed responses reside physically in D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-office-seal-pass2/. The logical path is data/raw/2026-10-24-office-seal-pass2/. Source manifests and aggregate coverage remain in the experiment package. No corpus coverage, individual context, count total, die attribution or office credence is revised.

We add three registered workshop-context assertions from HARP's public captions: H2001-5087/2934-01, H2001-5084/2913-07 and H2001-5068/2913-01. The individual rows remain local-only under data/raw/2026-10-24-tablet-use-pass2/registered-contexts-v1.json, physically D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-tablet-use-pass2/. They have no new CISI joins and are outside the target clump population.

The source manifest records complete response hashes and access failures. Raw HTML/PDF requests returned 403, so retained web responses are the available text witnesses. The 2001 internal links failed separately with 502/404. The 2005 PDF is metadata-only in this pass. Maintain the full report and unit-8040 field records as precise remaining acquisition targets. Shared DATA.md and MANIFEST.json remain unchanged for maintainer integration.

Record matches, attachment/residue/wear/cancellation, clump documentation and registered contents/allotment associations. Unreported fields stay unknown. Shared inscription does not establish a die match. Modern research moulds do not establish ancient impressions. Preserve all web responses and detailed notes under D:. Track only source metadata and aggregates in the checkout.

The [protocol](PROTOCOL.md) froze six queries and eight source opens before outcomes. Its SHA-256 is A108330D9EA6A6ECE99F21626FABE9F3CF9FF1386CFE02288109F6FFB29CBC45. The [aggregate](aggregate-v1.json), [source manifest](source-manifest-v1.json) and [validation](validation-v1.json) account for five inspected HTML responses, two failed links and one PDF metadata response. Direct acquisition of all six successful source URLs returned HTTP 403. Preserved web responses therefore supply the local textual witnesses; the PDF returned no readable content and supports no chapter-content claim. No images were displayed. All source responses and detailed registration rows are on D: through the logical data/raw path recorded in the manifest.

We froze the case population, carrier controls and six-query/eight-open bound before the web search. The earlier 2000 chapter was left frozen. Public HARP captions supplied three explicit workshop registrations and one unregistered comparison of handwriting groups. We kept manufacturing context, proposed discard cause and operational use as separate claims.

Frozen 24 October 2026 before new source searches. Authors: gpt-6.1-sol, Codex collaboration. We apply the repository add-data and start-study skills. Scope Q-1032: Lothal plate XXXVIII and Street 1/6 direction conflict; original TF-19 laboratory entry and its wall/deposit relation; Dholavira southern castle additions, section-plan joins and sample metadata. Search at most twelve query strings and acquire at most four new primary or institutional sources. Inspect at most twelve new source pages; retain failed source routes. Stop after that bounded search if exact records remain unavailable.

Admit actual original laboratory/report content and institutional survey metadata. Catalogue records establish availability only. Verify plate presence in any replacement Lothal edition. Preserve the preliminary status of the held Dholavira scan. Classify foundation, repair, redeposited fill, reuse and restoration separately. TL means thermoluminescence. A printed north arrow supplies no independently surveyed true-north control. No bearings, calibration, star tests, decipherment or new cohort are produced; bench is inapplicable to source acquisition.

All new sources, response bodies and detailed records stay physically at D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-town-phase-pass2/ (logical data/raw/2026-10-24-town-phase-pass2/). Track only code, prose, manifests and aggregates. Log source exposure including inscription imagery when present. Validate hashes, counts and bindings; list remaining acquisition fields precisely. Prior packages and shared registers remain frozen.

For the five inherited HARP figure routes, retain the year, lot and item fields separately. Their four-digit middle tokens conform to the unregistered-object convention described by Kenoyer and Meadow (2010), printed page 3, footnote 4. The figure publication and primary object image remain unresolved. The seven dispositions and acquisition responses are local under data/raw/2026-10-24-unit-source-pass2/, physically D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-unit-source-pass2/.

Search bounds are three targeted web queries per HARP identifier, up to ten institutional/publisher pages for CISI 3.1/3.2 access, and the held Dholavira report and metadata for the two excavation numbers. We coordinate Dholavira acquisition with direction 1. We inspect no repeated H1001 plate unless a new source supplies a parts-versus-sides bridge. Stop after all seven have dispositions and the access bounds are exhausted. Preserve unsuccessful routes and edition mismatches.

All new source payloads, extracts, imagery and scratch stay physically under D:/projects/indus_valley_script/data/raw/2026-10-24-unit-source-pass2/, logically data/raw/2026-10-24-unit-source-pass2/. Only code, prose, manifests and aggregate results stay in this package. Previous packages, shared maps, bench state and models are frozen. This is a source-acquisition study with no new segmentation, key or functional claim; bench/README.md was consulted and no applicable scoring proposal is submitted.

Twelve author checks pass in verification-v2.json: seven unique targets, five Harappa routes, no admitted crop, conservation of the 42-face queue, the frozen protocol hash, D: storage, all source and derivative hashes, candidate status, no confirmation read, and both final crop dimensions. The logical-path check confirms repository-relative data/raw paths beside physical D: paths.
